options.description: The unattended run pauses at the question until you answer it, so such runs can stall. You said questions should always be answered, and a scripted answer is not you answering.
options.label: Wait for my real answer (Recommended)

options.description: A scripted stand-in answers so the run keeps going. Those answers are not yours and you don't check them.
options.label: A script answers in my place

payload.question:
When plumb runs a session with no way to ask you questions, such as the benchmark's unattended runs, and a question for you comes up, should a script answer it in your place, or should that run stop and wait for your real answer?

You said on 30 Oct: "I mean, questions should always be answered no?"
payload.text: Depends in what case, if it's for evaluate and the questions are about bug fixing, yes come back to me. If the questions are related to intent specification inside the evaluate loop, that shouldnt come back to me and probably be scripted
